name: assetpanda/lp-feature-tabs
title: AP Lp Feature Tabs
description: Feature library: centred heading over pill tabs (CSS-only, no script) that switch between grids of checked features, each a title and a line of copy; three across on desktop, two on tablets, one on phones. With one tab the bar is left out and the grid shows alone. Live: the 'Explore all of our features' tabs (bs-tab-slider) on /solutions/asset-management-ot-ga/. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
